sourceSnapshot.note: The owner's review worksheet artifact is no longer reachable at its origin URL. The marks survive in the committed snapshot at source/locked-2026-09-17.json, which is preserved verbatim, so the human review is no longer a single unrecoverable local file.

unanswerable.suitable: label correct: nothing in the corpus fits

stateMapping.reviewed: human confirmed the machine label: for gold, the labelled skill meets the need; for unanswerable, nothing in the corpus fits
stateMapping.corrected: human rejected the machine label. betterSkillId may name an alternative, but is not always given
stateMapping.uncertain: human was unsure. NEVER counted as correct and NEVER counted as a miss. Excluded from every absolute label-derived metric.
stateMapping.unreviewed: no human adjudication exists. Derived as the absence of a row; never written into the overlay.

claimLimits: Absolute label-derived metrics may only be stated over the adjudicated subset. The 100-label historical set is machine-authored and is retained as evidence, not as ground truth.
The full 100-label set remains valid for paired same-input deltas between systems, with the machine-label provenance disclosed alongside the number.
This overlay contains no threshold, no floor, and no admission policy. Nothing in retrieval reads it.
